metadata.title: Why One Subagent Query Saved 48% of the Context Window
metadata.purpose: Claude-branded explainer, review slate cut. Mechanism: inline research reads all its source documents into the main context window, displacing build work; a subagent runs in its own isolated context and returns only a summary, leaving the main session's build context untouched.
metadata.color_semantics: TEAL = subagent / isolated context / build preserved; CRIMSON (terracotta) = inline research / context bloated / build displaced; never swap mid-film.
metadata.note: Exclusions honored: NO subagent configuration YAML walkthrough, NO multi-agent orchestration patterns, NO Writer/Reviewer pattern, NO auto memory discussion. One mechanism: inline research bloats main context; subagent isolates it, returns summary.

props.segment: Why One Subagent Query Saved 48% of the Context Window
props.command: Why did one subagent query save 48% of the context window?

beats.narration_text: The grading-tool session has been running for an hour. Thirty percent context used. The teacher needs to investigate the late-submission policy. They ask Claude — in the same session — to read the policy docs. The session hits seventy-eight percent context. Twenty-two percent remains.

The context window is the session's working memory. Every file Claude reads in the session stays there. The grading build: thirty percent. The policy doc, the LMS export, the meeting notes, three policy revisions: forty-eight percent more. Total: seventy-eight percent. The remaining twenty-two percent is barely enough for one student's feedback.

production_viz.label: CONTEXT WINDOW · ONE SESSION
production_viz.mechanic: vertical context bar filling: 30% teal (BUILD), 48% crimson (RESEARCH), 22% remains bracketed at top

beats.narration_text: Here is the question. Adding a research task to a productive session should extend the session's usefulness. Here is the session where a ten-minute research task left only twenty-two percent of the context window for the remaining build work. Why?

lines: Forty-eight percent of the window, gone.

beats.narration_text: Every file Claude reads in a session stays in that session's context window. The research reads the policy doc — in the window. Reads the LMS export — in the window. Reads the meeting notes, three policy revisions, a section of the syllabus — all in the window. The session has no way to unread a file. The research work and the build work share the same space, and the space does not grow.

production_viz.label: ONE WINDOW · NO UNREAD
production_viz.mechanic: one context bar; four crimson blocks arrive in sequence (POLICY DOC, LMS EXPORT, MEETING NOTES, SYLLABUS) and stack, pushing the bar toward full

beats.narration_text: A subagent is a Claude session that runs in its own isolated context window. The main session tells it what to read. The subagent reads everything in its own window. The subagent returns only a summary — three paragraphs, three hundred words. The main session receives the summary. The main session's context grows by three hundred words, not by every file the subagent read.

production_viz.label: SUBAGENT · MAIN SESSION
production_viz.mechanic: two boxes side by side; left SUBAGENT fills crimson with the four reads; right MAIN SESSION stays teal; arrow labeled SUMMARY (300 WORDS) crosses from left to right; MAIN grows by only the arrow

beats.narration_text: The side-by-side. Without subagent: grading build at thirty percent, research reads push to seventy-eight percent, twenty-two percent remains. With subagent: grading build at thirty percent, subagent summary adds two percent, the window is at thirty-two percent. The build context is intact. The research is done.

production_viz.label: WITHOUT SUBAGENT · WITH SUBAGENT
production_viz.mechanic: two 0-100% bars: LEFT 30% teal + 48% crimson = 78% used, 22% remains; RIGHT 30% teal + 2% teal = 32% used, 68% remains

beats.narration_text: Here is where this bites in the classroom. The teacher's grading tool processes twenty-five submissions. Without subagent: Claude reads all twenty-five into the main session. The session degrades. The last five students get shallower analysis than the first five. With a pattern-analyzer subagent: all twenty-five are read in the subagent's window. The main session gets a structured pattern report. The session quality is uniform across all twenty-five.

production_viz.label: 25 SUBMISSIONS · UNIFORM QUALITY
production_viz.mechanic: two panels: LEFT 25 tally rows fill main session directly; quality gradient degrades bottom rows to faded ink. RIGHT 25 tally rows feed a SUBAGENT box; single PATTERN REPORT arrow enters MAIN SESSION; all 25 marks stay full ink

beats.narration_text: The heuristic: if the task reads more than the main session needs to see, it is a subagent task. Research tasks with many source docs. Pattern analysis across a corpus. Any work that generates a large intermediate read that can be compressed into a short summary. The subagent is not overhead. It is the design choice that makes long builds possible.

production_viz.label: THE HEURISTIC
production_viz.mechanic: two-row teal card: 'READS MORE THAN SESSION NEEDS → SUBAGENT'; 'COMPRESSIBLE TO A SUMMARY → SUBAGENT'; caption THE SUBAGENT IS THE DESIGN

beats.narration_text: Research fills context. The subagent takes the fill. The main session keeps the build.

lines: The main session keeps the build.

beats.narration_text: The verdict. Reads in the main session's window stay there for the rest of the run. A subagent runs in its own window and returns only the summary. That is why one query moved the research from forty-eight percent of the context to two.

props.artifactTitle: Why One Subagent Query Saved 48% of the Context Window
artifactLines: Reads in the main session's window stay there — the session cannot unread a file.
A subagent runs in its own window and returns only the summary.
Research moves from 48% of the window to about 2%.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Pick a Claude session where you have watched context fill on research reads — a policy question, a code archaeology dive, a corpus scan. Ask Claude to launch that same read as a subagent and return only the finding. Report your before-and-after context usage.

props.topic: YOUR TURN · CLAUDE CODE FOR TEACHERS
